# For the Animals: An Argument Guide

> The argument guide for animal advocates systematically catalogs every idea used to exploit, harm or kill animals or to avoid helping them, with a thorough explanation of the objections and biases of people who oppose veganism and antispeciesism.

## Main pages
- [Start here](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/start-here.html)
- [All arguments](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/#arguments)
- [Simulated debate](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/debate.html)
- [Practice answers](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/practice.html)
- [Stop saying this: weak vegan arguments and better ways to say them](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/stop-saying.html)
- [Political objections](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/political-objections.html)
- [Beyond veganism](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/beyond-veganism.html)
- [The 13 families](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/families.html)

- [Map of connections](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/map.html)
- [Fallacies](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/fallacies.html)
- [Biases](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/biases.html)
- [Library](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/library.html)
